sketch:

intermediate image A₁B₁ just inside F₂ of the oculaire f'₂; oculaire
then acts as a loupe producing a virtual image at infinity. HUD
prints G = γ₁ · G_oc = (Δ/f'₁)·(d_m/f'₂). Student drags AB near F₁
to see A₁B₁ shift. Experiment: 3 seeded (γ₁, G_oc) targets; student
sets f'₁, f'₂, tube length Δ. Evaluate: intermediate rays and A₁B₁
hidden; only final virtual image angle shown; student picks
parameters blind.
